methods: Stats NZ POPES_SUB_009 1.0: 30 June 2025 provisional estimated resident population; YEAR=2025, SEX=3 total people, AGE=999999 total ages, exact four-digit AREA. Bind the literal own Wikidata item, settlement P31 scope, own name, P131 chain to same state, compatible type/type_local and no parent conflict. Original point must lie in exact official named 2023 clipped and 2026 urban polygons; stable official code and published ASCII/macron name pair join the 2025 estimate codelist. These are identity screens across editions, not a claim of equal boundary geometry. Do not use a city district, rural aggregate or SA2 count for a town or suburb; retain every unresolved identity or conflicting evidence as a hold. No Wikidata population used.
